sources.summary: Learn how to build an end-to-end security assessment pipeline for AI agent skills using NVIDIA SkillSpector and LangGraph. In this tutorial, we construct a synthetic skill marketplace, scan for malicious prompt injection, credential access, and risky dependencies, and implement custom YARA rules, baseline suppressions, and CI deployment gates. The post Building an Advanced AI Skill Security Auditing Pipeline with NVIDIA SkillSpector, LangGraph, YARA Rules, SARIF, and CI Policy Gates appeared first on MarkTechPost .
